title: Kevin Hern Sold Seagate and Texas Instruments Stock: $15K–$50K Each (Oct 2026)

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
5 days for the Seagate sale and 14 days for the Texas Instruments sale. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
